about.text: A cow's-milk cheese, white, soft and not creamy, with a pale rind and a cylindrical shape of 3 to 7 kg. Made mainly in the Province of Belluno in Veneto, with some in Val di Fiemme in Trentino; it can be eaten fresh or aged, and it gets sharper as it ripens.
